name: 597. A session a custom provider's allowed_requests leaves out is refused as unsupported_operation (session allowed requests)
description: TXE-7423. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: start tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs, start an isolated gateway on tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json and run with providerErrorFixture=1; every case is skipped otherwise. TXE-7370 (#292) moved the allowed_requests check for realtime, live and WebSocket Responses sessions into key selection, which returned a plain error that every session handler answered as invalid_request_error. Before TXE-7370 the provider's own check refused these sessions with code unsupported_operation, and the GPT Live e2e suite (tests/live) expects it. The fixture config's xiaomi provider is OpenAI-based and allows only chat, so it leaves out realtime and live. Row 1 asks for a realtime client secret, row 2 sends a realtime WebRTC offer and row 3 opens a GPT Live WebRTC session; each must answer 400 with code unsupported_operation. WebSocket sessions cannot be opened from newman: tests/live covers them, and transports/bifrost-http/handlers/selectkeyrefusal_test.go covers every session type.
